name.description: The terminal's name, as terminal_list shows it

pattern.description: Regular expression, tried against output that arrives after the monitor is created

nonZeroOnly.description: Only fire when the exit code is not 0

minutes.description: Minutes the agent has been working on its current input

to.description: For message: who receives it, as service:id (telegram:123, slack:C012) or group:name

minSecondsBetween.description: Matches closer together than this are counted but do not fire

maxFirings.description: After this many firings the monitor disables itself
